help.show: What is this and how does it work?
help.whyText: This integration lets the platform automatically upload seminar video files directly to the official Pensa Club YouTube channel. The video can then be embedded on the seminar page without using Firebase Storage and without a time limit. The connection is made only once — the token is kept on the server and refreshed automatically.
help.howTitle: How do I connect the channel?
help.step2: You'll be redirected to Google — sign in with the account that manages the Pensa Club channel.
help.step3: Grant the app permission to upload and manage videos.
help.step4: You'll be returned here with status "Connected". A "Upload to YouTube" button will then appear in the seminar's Videos section.
help.perm1: Uploading videos to the channel (uploaded as "unlisted" by default — accessible only via link).
help.perm2: Deleting videos we uploaded (so you can remove a video from a seminar).
help.note1: Only one admin needs to connect — after that, all admins can upload videos without signing into Google again.
help.note2: If you change your Google account password or revoke the permission from Google settings — you'll need to reconnect.
help.note3: YouTube daily upload limit: ~6 videos/day for unverified projects. The limit is removed after verification.
